§6Steam Power Generation§f

§aConverting thermal energy to electrical power via steam.§f
Steam power is the standard way to get RF from nuclear reactors. Heat water in a §bCoolant Heater§f or §bSteam Generator§f, pipe the resulting §bHigh Pressure Steam§f into a §bSteam Turbine§f, and collect the RF.

The basic loop: Water in, heat from reactor, steam out, turbine spins, RF comes out. Simple in concept, but the execution requires careful pipe routing and fluid management.

§ePS:§f Steam power scales well with reactor size. Build bigger turbines and more heaters as your reactor output grows. It's the most efficient way to convert nuclear heat to power.
